Do I need an engineer to run experiments?
No. Copy, layout and flow experiments launch from the dashboard. Engineers only get involved when a test needs new code.

What counts as a tracked user?
Anyone who triggers at least one event in a calendar month. Anonymous visitors who never sign in are free.
